entry.name: decode
entry.digest: Send 1 or 0 out a specific outlet
entry.description: Provides hierarchical switching. The right inlet turns all outlets off, switch, while the middle inlet turns all outlets on. The right inlet overrides the middle inlet, and the middle inlet overrides numnbers sent to the left inlet that turn individual outlets on or off.

arguments.name: outlets
arguments.description: Sets the number of outlets. The default is one outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: The messagecausesto output its current state.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In middle inlet: If a 1 was last received in the right inlet, any number received in the middle outlet will send a 0 out all outlets. Otherwise, a number greater than 0 received in the middle inlet sends a 1 out all outlets. If 0 is received in the middle inlet, decode sends a 1 out the last outlet decoded by a number received in the left inlet, and 0 out all other outlets.

messages.name: in2
messages.description: In right inlet: Any positive number other than 0 sends a 0 out all outlets. Whenreceives a 0 in its right inlet, it outputs 0 or 1 out its outlets based on the values last received in the middle and left inlets.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Select an outlet to turn on
messages.description: In left inlet: An index (starting with 0 for the left outlet) that specifies an outlet out to turn on, turning off all other outlets.
